question: A rectangle \(OACB\) with the two axes as two sides, the origin \(O\) as a vertex is drawn in which the length \(OA\) is four times the width \(OB\). A circle is drawn passing through the points \(B\) and \(C\) and touching \(OA\) at its mid-point, thus dividing the rectangle into three parts. Find the ratio of the areas of these three parts.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
